newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwabo falls on expected special loss.
newsitem.headline: Daiwabo falls on expected special loss.

text.p: Shares in Daiwabo Co Ltd fell in early trade on Friday following its announcement that earnings for the year to March 31 will include an extraordinary loss due to the dissolution of three units, traders said.

The textile maker said on Thursday it would include an extraordinary loss of 5.86 billion yen in parent earnings for the year as the three units would be dissolved, but that it would maintain its earnings forecast for the year.
Daiwabo said its accounts would include a special profit to offset the expected special loss.
Daiwabo was down 16 yen at 359 by 0058 GMT on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. It was down 18 yen at 362 yen by 0059 GMT at the Osaka Securities Exchange.
